notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wingmantle Chaplain, adding {C}{C}.
Wingmantle Chaplain dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Wingmantle Chaplain from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Wingmantle Chaplain enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least two 1/1 Bird creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Bird, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
